_comment: THE corpus every provenance-note reader is held to. One file, read by the
backend test, the frontend test and the script-twin test, so 'the parsers
accept an identical corpus' is a fact about this file and not a claim.
The note is a STORED DATA CONTRACT: an MRP-raised PO carries no per-line
so_item_id, so this note is the only record of which Sales Orders it was
bought for. Rows written under EVERY label below exist in production, so a
reader that drops one loses that PO's provenance with no error at all.
`expect` is the SET of source doc numbers the note resolves to. Order is
the note's own order; readers de-duplicate.

cases.name: current label, one source order
current label, several source orders
cases.note: Transfer from Sales Order: SO-2699-001, SO-2699-002, SO-2699-003

cases.name: current label, company-prefixed doc numbers
LEGACY plural label, one source order
LEGACY plural label, several source orders
LEGACY plural label, company-prefixed doc number
LEGACY singular label
label case is not significant — notes are hand-edited too
legacy label, lower case
leading and trailing whitespace around the whole note
ragged spacing around the commas
cases.note: Transfer from Sales Order:   SO-2699-001 ,SO-2699-002 ,  SO-2699-003

cases.name: repeated doc number collapses to one
cases.note: Transfer from Sales Order: SO-2699-001, SO-2699-001, SO-2699-002

cases.name: trailing comma yields no empty token
the label on its own line inside a longer note — the FIRST match wins
cases.note:
Supplier confirmed the ETA by phone.
Transfer from Sales Order: SO-2699-001, SO-2699-002

cases.name: LEGACY label on a later line
a plain free-text note is NOT provenance
prose that merely mentions the words carries no colon and no list
cases.note: raised to cover a shortage, transfer from sales order handled by MRP

cases.name: the label mid-line is not a provenance record
cases.note: See remarks. Transfer from Sales Order: SO-2699-001

cases.name: the label with nothing after it records nothing
an empty note
